_doc: The suites' fixture for project sharingu (engine/tools/suites/load-fixtures.mjs files it through preview then file, as the owner, on every fresh suite org; tools/lib.sh suite_local_up seeds one project per fixture file, keyed by `project`). Knowledge carries no eval mark; the one contribution is eval-marked (eval: true rides the preview). The qids are card ids (src/handoff.js HANDOFF_CARD_RE) so a wrap_up may answer them. QSUITE1 and QSUITE2: evals.sh answers them through wrap_up (eval answers never rule). QSUITE3: sims.sh S9 rules it. QSUITE4: sims.sh S5 files a ruling claim on it. Only QSUITE3 is owed by the owner, so Home's needs-you keeps room for the approve row sims.sh S10 presses (Home draws four rows).
